tables.name: Dim_Asset
tables.description: One row per asset, derived from raw equipment metadata; no preaggregated risk or outcome columns.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/dim_asset.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"asset_id", type text}, {"asset_type", type text}, {"site", type text}, {"install_date", type date}, {"default_downtime_cost_per_hour", type number}}, "en-CA")
in
    Typed

tables.name: Dim_Site
tables.description: One row per synthetic Alberta site. Direct filters to each fact; no Site-to-Asset relationship diamond.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/dim_site.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"site", type text}, {"latitude", type number}, {"longitude", type number}}, "en-CA")
in
    Typed

tables.name: Dim_UserSite
tables.description: Disconnected access mapping, one row per allowed UPN/site pair. Demonstration identities require deployment-specific replacement.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/dim_user_site.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"user_principal_name", type text}, {"site", type text}}, "en-CA"),
    NormalizedUsers = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"user_principal_name", each Text.Lower(Text.Trim(_)), type text}})
in
    NormalizedUsers

tables.name: Config_Model
tables.description: Disconnected evaluation bounds and validation-selected alert threshold. Not an outcome summary.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/model_settings.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"evaluation_start", type date}, {"evaluation_end", type date}, {"alert_threshold", type number}}, "en-CA")
in
    Typed

tables.name: Fact_ServiceVisits
tables.description: One visit per policy/asset/service date. Includes carry-in ledger rows, excluded from incurred cost measures.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/service_visits.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"policy", type text}, {"asset_id", type text}, {"asset_type", type text}, {"site", type text}, {"alert_date", type date}, {"service_date", type date}, {"event_id", type text}, {"outcome", type text}, {"planned_cost_cad", type number}, {"planned_downtime_hours", type number}}, "en-CA"),
    Logical = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"in_evaluation_window", each if _ = null then null else if List.Contains({"1", "1.0", "true"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then true else if List.Contains({"0", "0.0", "false"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then false else error "Invalid boolean", type nullable logical}})
in
    Logical

tables.name: Fact_Readings
tables.description: One observation per asset/day; policy-agnostic sensor history shared by every replayed policy. Blank targets remain blank.

columns.name: target_failure_30d
columns.description: target failure 30d; null means outcome is not fully observed.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/scored_readings.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"date", type date}, {"asset_id", type text}, {"asset_type", type text}, {"site", type text}, {"vibration_mm_s", type number}, {"bearing_temperature_c", type number}, {"pressure_bar", type number}, {"power_kw", type number}, {"load_pct", type number}, {"rpm", type number}, {"runtime_hours", type number}, {"age_days", Int64.Type}, {"sensor_missing_count", Int64.Type}, {"risk_score", type number}}, "en-CA"),
    Logical = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"alert", each if _ = null then null else if List.Contains({"1", "1.0", "true"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then true else if List.Contains({"0", "0.0", "false"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then false else error "Invalid boolean", type nullable logical}, {"target_failure_30d", each if _ = null then null else if List.Contains({"1", "1.0", "true"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then true else if List.Contains({"0", "0.0", "false"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then false else error "Invalid boolean", type nullable logical}}),
    RiskBand = Table.AddColumn(Logical, "risk_band", each if [risk_score] = null then "No score" else if [risk_score] < 0.1 then "00-10%" else if [risk_score] < 0.2 then "10-20%" else if [risk_score] < 0.3 then "20-30%" else if [risk_score] < 0.4 then "30-40%" else if [risk_score] < 0.5 then "40-50%" else if [risk_score] < 0.6 then "50-60%" else if [risk_score] < 0.7 then "60-70%" else if [risk_score] < 0.8 then "70-80%" else if [risk_score] < 0.9 then "80-90%" else "90-100%", type text),
    LabelStatus = Table.AddColumn(RiskBand, "label_status", each if [target_failure_30d] = null then "Unlabeled / censored" else if [target_failure_30d] then "Failure within 30 days" else "No failure within 30 days", type text)
in
    LabelStatus

tables.name: Fact_Events
tables.description: One physical failure event per maintenance-policy replay. Event date is the accounting date for repair/unplanned downtime.

source.expression:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(DataFolder & "/event_outcomes.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    BlankToNull = Table.ReplaceValue(Headers, "", null, Replacer.ReplaceValue, Table.ColumnNames(Headers)),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(BlankToNull, {{"event_id", type text}, {"asset_id", type text}, {"asset_type", type text}, {"site", type text}, {"event_date", type date}, {"policy", type text}, {"alert_date", type date}, {"service_date", type date}, {"warning_days", type number}, {"service_lead_days", type number}, {"repair_cost_cad", type number}, {"downtime_hours", type number}}, "en-CA"),
    Logical = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"caught", each if _ = null then null else if List.Contains({"1", "1.0", "true"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then true else if List.Contains({"0", "0.0", "false"}, Text.Lower(Text.From(_))) then false else error "Invalid boolean", type nullable logical}}),
    OutcomeLabel = Table.AddColumn(Logical, "outcome_label", each if [caught] then "Caught" else "Missed / breakdown", type text),
    WarningBand = Table.AddColumn(OutcomeLabel, "warning_band", each if not [caught] then "Missed / 0 days" else if [warning_days] < 8 then "01-07 days" else if [warning_days] < 15 then "08-14 days" else if [warning_days] < 22 then "15-21 days" else if [warning_days] <= 30 then "22-30 days" else "31+ days", type text),
    WarningBandOrder = Table.AddColumn(WarningBand, "warning_band_order", each if not [caught] then 0 else if [warning_days] < 8 then 1 else if [warning_days] < 15 then 2 else if [warning_days] < 22 then 3 else if [warning_days] <= 30 then 4 else 5, Int64.Type)
in
    WarningBandOrder

tables.name: Dim_Policy
tables.description: Three mutually exclusive maintenance scenarios replayed on the same history; filters events and visits, not policy-agnostic readings.

source.expression:
let
    Source = #table(type table [policy=text, policy_label=text, policy_order=Int64.Type], {{"reactive", "Reactive", 1}, {"fixed_90_day", "Fixed interval (90 days)", 2}, {"predictive", "Predictive", 3}})
in
    Source

tables.name: Dim_Date
tables.description: Complete gapless calendar year(s) around evaluation, marked Time with a unique Date key. The current evaluation calendar contains 365 dates.

source.expression:
let
    Start = #date(Date.Year(List.Min(Config_Model[evaluation_start])), 1, 1),
    End = #date(Date.Year(List.Max(Config_Model[evaluation_end])), 12, 31),
    Dates = Table.FromList(List.Dates(Start, Duration.Days(End - Start) + 1, #duration(1, 0, 0, 0)), Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"Date"}),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Dates, {{"Date", type date}}),
    Year = Table.AddColumn(Typed, "Year", each Date.Year([Date]), Int64.Type),
    MonthNumber = Table.AddColumn(Year, "MonthNumber", each Date.Month([Date]), Int64.Type),
    Month = Table.AddColumn(MonthNumber, "Month", each Date.ToText([Date], "MMM", "en-CA"), type text),
    YearMonth = Table.AddColumn(Month, "YearMonth", each Date.ToText([Date], "yyyy-MM"), type text)
in
    YearMonth

tables.name: KPI_Measures
tables.description: Explicit measures with documented grains, denominators and filter behavior.

measures.name: Selected Policy
measures.description: Policy in context; predictive when unfiltered. An explicit multiple-policy selection returns blank to prevent adding mutually exclusive scenarios.
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE(Dim_Policy[policy]), SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[policy]), IF(NOT ISFILTERED(Dim_Policy), "predictive", BLANK()))

measures.name: Policy Selection Note
measures.description: Visible policy scope, including the default and ambiguous multiple selections.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy), "Choose one policy for comparable totals", IF(NOT ISFILTERED(Dim_Policy), "Predictive policy (default)", SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Policy[policy_label])))

measures.name: Observed Days
measures.description: Distinct observed calendar days in the selected date/site/asset scope and evaluation window. Zero-event days count. RLS remains in force.
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Readings[date]),
        KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
        KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd),
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy)
    )

measures.name: Evaluation Years
measures.description: Selected observed days divided by 365.25; full evaluation is 91 days, not a full observed year.
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Observed Days], 365.25)

measures.name: Asset Years
measures.description: Observed asset-days divided by 365.25; exposure diagnostic, not the fleet annualization denominator.
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
VAR AssetDays = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Readings), KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart), KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd), REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy))
RETURN DIVIDE(AssetDays, 365.25)

measures.name: Downtime Cost Per Hour Value
measures.description: Uniform downtime-cost what-if value. Takes effect only in Uniform override mode.
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE(Param_DowntimeCost[Downtime Cost Per Hour], 1000)

measures.name: Cost Mode
measures.description: Equipment defaults retain the original scenario assumptions; Uniform override applies the selected rate to every asset.
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE(Param_CostMode[Cost Mode], "Equipment defaults")

measures.name: Emergency Repair Cost
measures.description: Repair costs recognized on failure date in the selected policy/date scope.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUM(Fact_Events[repair_cost_cad]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Planned Service Cost
measures.description: Planned service costs recognized on service date. Carry-in visits stay in the audit ledger but are not charged again.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUM(Fact_ServiceVisits[planned_cost_cad]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Unplanned Downtime Cost
measures.description: Atomic downtime hours multiplied by the related equipment rate, or the live uniform-rate scenario. Date, site, asset and RLS filters are retained.
measures.expression:
VAR UseUniformRate = [Cost Mode] = "Uniform override"
VAR UniformRate = [Downtime Cost Per Hour Value]
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUMX(Fact_Events, Fact_Events[downtime_hours] * IF(UseUniformRate, UniformRate, RELATED(Dim_Asset[default_downtime_cost_per_hour]))),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Planned Downtime Cost
measures.description: Atomic downtime hours multiplied by the related equipment rate, or the live uniform-rate scenario. Date, site, asset and RLS filters are retained.
measures.expression:
VAR UseUniformRate = [Cost Mode] = "Uniform override"
VAR UniformRate = [Downtime Cost Per Hour Value]
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUMX(Fact_ServiceVisits, Fact_ServiceVisits[planned_downtime_hours] * IF(UseUniformRate, UniformRate, RELATED(Dim_Asset[default_downtime_cost_per_hour]))),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Total Cost
measures.description: Emergency repair plus planned service plus all incurred downtime cost. A day with observations and no costs returns zero.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR IncurredCost = COALESCE([Emergency Repair Cost], 0) + COALESCE([Planned Service Cost], 0) + COALESCE([Unplanned Downtime Cost], 0) + COALESCE([Planned Downtime Cost], 0)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy) && [Observed Days] > 0, IncurredCost)

measures.name: Annualized Cost
measures.description: Fleet cost annualized over selected observed days. This is a synthetic extrapolation, not realized savings or an observed full year.
measures.expression:
VAR IncurredCost = [Total Cost]
VAR ExposureYears = [Evaluation Years]
RETURN DIVIDE(IncurredCost, ExposureYears)

measures.name: Cost Avoided vs Reactive
measures.description: Annualized reactive cost minus the current policy cost. The baseline re-evaluates the measure inside CALCULATE and removes only policy filters; site/date/asset/RLS and cost parameters remain.
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedCost = [Annualized Cost]
VAR ReactiveCost = CALCULATE([Annualized Cost], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "reactive")
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(SelectedCost), ReactiveCost - SelectedCost)

measures.name: Reactive Annualized Cost
measures.description: Explicit policy comparison with the same date, site, asset, security and cost scenario scope.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Annualized Cost], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "reactive")

measures.name: Fixed Annualized Cost
measures.description: Explicit policy comparison with the same date, site, asset, security and cost scenario scope.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Annualized Cost], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "fixed_90_day")

measures.name: Predictive Annualized Cost
measures.description: Explicit policy comparison with the same date, site, asset, security and cost scenario scope.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Annualized Cost], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "predictive")

measures.name: Cost Avoided vs Fixed
measures.description: Predictive annualized net cost advantage over the fixed 90-day maintenance scenario.
measures.expression: [Fixed Annualized Cost] - [Predictive Annualized Cost]

measures.name: Waterfall Cost
measures.description: Three additive waterfall bars reach predictive annual cost. Predictive total is reserved for a total marker, never added as another change.
measures.expression:
VAR Stage = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_CostStep[Step])
RETURN SWITCH(Stage,
    "Reactive baseline", [Reactive Annualized Cost],
    "Fixed schedule change", [Fixed Annualized Cost] - [Reactive Annualized Cost],
    "Predictive change", [Predictive Annualized Cost] - [Fixed Annualized Cost],
    "Predictive total", [Predictive Annualized Cost],
    BLANK())

measures.name: Event Count
measures.description: Events for one maintenance policy. Scenarios replay the same physical failures and must not be added across policies.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Events), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Caught Events
measures.description: Failure events prevented by a successful intervention in the chosen policy.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Events), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_Events[caught] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Missed Events
measures.description: Failures not prevented in the chosen maintenance policy, including unsuccessful interventions.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Events), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_Events[caught] = FALSE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Breakdowns
measures.description: Breakdown means caught=false events. Uses predictive policy when policy is unfiltered; select one other policy to compare. Never a synonym for the caught Boolean column.
measures.expression: [Missed Events]

measures.name: Catch Rate
measures.description: Successfully prevented failure events divided by all events for the selected policy; event-level, not classifier recall.
measures.expression:
VAR Caught = [Caught Events]
VAR EligibleEvents = [Event Count]
RETURN DIVIDE(COALESCE(Caught, 0), EligibleEvents)

measures.name: Mean Warning Days
measures.description: Mean alert-to-failure lead time among caught events only. Blank for reactive maintenance because no events were caught.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            AVERAGE(Fact_Events[warning_days]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_Events[caught] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Median Warning Days
measures.description: Median warning among successfully caught events; excludes missed-event zeroes.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            MEDIAN(Fact_Events[warning_days]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_Events[caught] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Service Visits
measures.description: Charged visits whose service date lies within the evaluation window and current date selection.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Ledger Service Visits
measures.description: All recorded visits, including carry-in visits when their service dates are selected. Does not expand the date selection automatically.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy)
        )
    )

measures.name: Carry In Visits
measures.description: Audit-only visits preceding evaluation; excluded from incurred cost and operational false-alarm denominators.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = FALSE())
        )
    )

measures.name: Unnecessary Services
measures.description: Charged visits with this outcome; carry-in visits are excluded.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[outcome] = "no_actionable_failure"),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Unsuccessful Services
measures.description: Charged visits with this outcome; carry-in visits are excluded.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[outcome] = "intervention_unsuccessful"),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Successful Services
measures.description: Charged visits with this outcome; carry-in visits are excluded.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_ServiceVisits), 0),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[outcome] = "prevented_failure"),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: False Alarm Rate
measures.description: Operational false-alarm rate = no_actionable_failure visits / charged visits. This is not classifier FP/(FP+TN).
measures.expression:
VAR FalseAlarms = [Unnecessary Services]
VAR ChargedVisits = [Service Visits]
RETURN DIVIDE(COALESCE(FalseAlarms, 0), ChargedVisits)

measures.name: Unnecessary Service Rate
measures.description: Share of charged service visits with no actionable failure.
measures.expression: [False Alarm Rate]

measures.name: Unsuccessful Service Rate
measures.description: Share of charged visits where intervention did not prevent the actionable failure.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE([Unsuccessful Services], 0), [Service Visits])

measures.name: Unplanned Downtime Hours
measures.description: Unplanned downtime recognized on event date in the selected policy.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUM(Fact_Events[downtime_hours]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Planned Downtime Hours
measures.description: Planned downtime of charged service visits.
measures.expression:
VAR ChosenPolicy = [Selected Policy]
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Config_Model[evaluation_start])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Config_Model[evaluation_end])
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ChosenPolicy),
        CALCULATE(
            SUM(Fact_ServiceVisits[planned_downtime_hours]),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Policy[policy] = ChosenPolicy),
            KEEPFILTERS(Fact_ServiceVisits[in_evaluation_window] = TRUE()),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] >= PeriodStart),
            KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] <= PeriodEnd)
        )
    )

measures.name: Downtime Reduction vs Fixed
measures.description: Relative reduction in unplanned downtime for the predictive versus fixed-interval policy within identical filters.
measures.expression:
VAR FixedHours = CALCULATE([Unplanned Downtime Hours], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "fixed_90_day")
VAR PredictiveHours = CALCULATE([Unplanned Downtime Hours], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Policy), Dim_Policy[policy] = "predictive")
RETURN DIVIDE(FixedHours - PredictiveHours, FixedHours)

measures.name: Asset Count
measures.description: Assets with observations in the selected date/site/asset scope, respecting RLS. Zero when there are no visible observations.
measures.expression: COALESCE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Readings[asset_id]), 0)

measures.name: Reading Count
measures.description: Daily asset observations; shared by all maintenance policies and never duplicated by policy. Zero for an empty visible set.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Readings), 0)

measures.name: Mean Risk Score
measures.description: Mean model risk score across selected daily observations. Scores are not separately calibrated probabilities.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[risk_score])

measures.name: Latest Risk Score
measures.description: Each asset's latest observed risk within selected dates; aggregate cells average these latest asset risks. Never sums risk or reads a precomputed asset-summary score.
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX(
    VALUES(Dim_Asset[asset_id]),
    VAR LatestObservedDate = CALCULATE(MAX(Fact_Readings[date]))
    RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(LatestObservedDate), CALCULATE(AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[risk_score]), KEEPFILTERS(Dim_Date[Date] = LatestObservedDate)))
)

measures.name: latest_risk_score
measures.description: Compatibility alias for Latest Risk Score.
measures.expression: [Latest Risk Score]

measures.name: Latest Observation Date
measures.description: Latest telemetry snapshot within the current asset/site/date/security scope.
measures.expression: MAX(Fact_Readings[date])

measures.name: Alert Threshold
measures.description: Decision threshold selected on validation data; fixed for the test period.
measures.expression: MAX(Config_Model[alert_threshold])

measures.name: Risk Score 7D Avg
measures.description: Trailing seven calendar days ending at the current visible latest observation. The date filter is replaced by that window; asset/site/RLS remain. Missing scores are excluded from the average.
measures.expression:
VAR LastObservedDate = MAX(Fact_Readings[date])
VAR WindowStart = LastObservedDate - 6
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(LastObservedDate),
    CALCULATE(
        [Mean Risk Score],
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date),
        DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], WindowStart, LastObservedDate)
    )
)

measures.name: Mean Vibration
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[vibration_mm_s])

measures.name: Mean Temperature
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[bearing_temperature_c])

measures.name: Mean Pressure
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[pressure_bar])

measures.name: Mean RPM
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[rpm])

measures.name: Mean Runtime Hours
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[runtime_hours])

measures.name: Mean Load
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[load_pct])

measures.name: Mean Power
measures.description: Mean sensor reading in the selected daily observations; units follow the source column.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Fact_Readings[power_kw])

measures.name: Sensor Gap Rate
measures.description: Share of asset-days with at least one originally missing sensor; dashboard readings contain the pipeline's imputed values.
measures.expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Readings), KEEPFILTERS(Fact_Readings[sensor_missing_count] > 0)), [Reading Count])

measures.name: Labeled Readings
measures.description: Observations with a fully observed 30-day outcome and nonblank prediction; right-censored target rows are excluded. Empty sets count as zero.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Readings, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d]) && NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[alert]))), 0)

measures.name: Unlabeled Readings
measures.description: Right-censored or unlabeled observations excluded from classifier performance, retained for risk operations.
measures.expression: [Reading Count] - [Labeled Readings]

measures.name: Prediction TP
measures.description: Asset-day classification count after excluding blank targets/predictions. Empty cells count as zero. Distinct from event-level catch rate.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Readings, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d]) && NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[alert]) && Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d] == TRUE() && Fact_Readings[alert] == TRUE())), 0)

measures.name: Prediction FP
measures.description: Asset-day classification count after excluding blank targets/predictions. Empty cells count as zero. Distinct from event-level catch rate.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Readings, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d]) && NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[alert]) && Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d] == FALSE() && Fact_Readings[alert] == TRUE())), 0)

measures.name: Prediction FN
measures.description: Asset-day classification count after excluding blank targets/predictions. Empty cells count as zero. Distinct from event-level catch rate.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Readings, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d]) && NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[alert]) && Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d] == TRUE() && Fact_Readings[alert] == FALSE())), 0)

measures.name: Prediction TN
measures.description: Asset-day classification count after excluding blank targets/predictions. Empty cells count as zero. Distinct from event-level catch rate.
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(Fact_Readings, NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d]) && NOT ISBLANK(Fact_Readings[alert]) && Fact_Readings[target_failure_30d] == FALSE() && Fact_Readings[alert] == FALSE())), 0)

measures.name: Confusion Count
measures.description: One confusion-matrix cell from disconnected actual/predicted label axes. Totals intentionally blank.
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_ConfusionActual[Actual])
VAR Predicted = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_ConfusionPredicted[Predicted])
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(),
    Actual = "Failure" && Predicted = "Failure", [Prediction TP],
    Actual = "No failure" && Predicted = "Failure", [Prediction FP],
    Actual = "Failure" && Predicted = "No failure", [Prediction FN],
    Actual = "No failure" && Predicted = "No failure", [Prediction TN],
    BLANK())

measures.name: Precision
measures.description: Asset-day positive predictive value among labeled rows.
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Prediction TP], [Prediction TP] + [Prediction FP])

measures.name: Recall
measures.description: Asset-day sensitivity among labeled rows; not the policy event catch rate.
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Prediction TP], [Prediction TP] + [Prediction FN])

measures.name: Classifier False Positive Rate
measures.description: FP/(FP+TN) on labeled asset-days, distinct from unnecessary service/charged visits.
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Prediction FP], [Prediction FP] + [Prediction TN])

measures.name: Current User
measures.description: Diagnostic UPN for security testing. Use the actual sign-in UPN, not an assumed email alias.
measures.expression: USERPRINCIPALNAME()

measures.name: Risk Status
measures.description: Latest model score versus the validation-selected threshold; a decision aid for the reliability engineer.
measures.expression:
VAR Risk = [Latest Risk Score]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Risk), "No observation", IF(Risk >= [Alert Threshold], "Inspect / dispatch", IF(Risk >= [Alert Threshold] / 2, "Watch trend", "Routine monitoring")))

measures.name: Risk Color
measures.description: Accessible severity palette for current asset risk. Always pair colour with Risk Status text.
measures.expression:
VAR Risk = [Latest Risk Score]
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Risk), "#64748B", Risk >= [Alert Threshold], "#B54747", Risk >= [Alert Threshold] / 2, "#B7791F", "#087F8C")

measures.name: Mean Risk
measures.description: Report binding alias for Mean Risk Score; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Mean Risk Score]

measures.name: Labeled Reading Count
measures.description: Report binding alias for Labeled Readings; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Labeled Readings]

measures.name: Latest Reading Date
measures.description: Report binding alias for Latest Observation Date; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Latest Observation Date]

measures.name: Latest Risk Status
measures.description: Report binding alias for Risk Status; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Risk Status]

measures.name: Latest Risk Color
measures.description: Report binding alias for Risk Color; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Risk Color]

measures.name: Breakdown Events
measures.description: Report binding alias for Breakdowns; same filter and denominator semantics.
measures.expression: [Breakdowns]

measures.name: Executive Insight
measures.description: Dynamic comparison statement that displays selected observed exposure and labels the scenario as synthetic.
measures.expression:
VAR Savings = [Cost Avoided vs Fixed]
VAR Days = [Observed Days]
VAR Assets = [Asset Count]
RETURN IF(Days > 0,
    "Predictive maintenance " & IF(Savings >= 0, "avoids ", "adds ") & "C$" & FORMAT(ABS(Savings), "#,##0", "en-CA") & "/year versus fixed service | " & FORMAT(Assets, "0") & " assets, " & FORMAT(Days, "0") & " observed days | Synthetic scenario",
    "No observed exposure in the selected site, asset and date scope")

measures.name: Fleet Queue Rank
measures.description: Unique latest-risk rank within selected site, asset and date context; descending score with asset ID as deterministic tie-break. Blank risks are excluded and RLS remains in force. Used only to bound the six-row Fleet queue.
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentAsset = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Asset[asset_id])
VAR CurrentRisk = [Latest Risk Score]
VAR Candidates =
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(Dim_Asset[asset_id]), "__QueueRisk", [Latest Risk Score]),
        NOT ISBLANK([__QueueRisk])
    )
RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK(CurrentAsset) && NOT ISBLANK(CurrentRisk),
        1 + COUNTROWS(
            FILTER(
                Candidates,
                [__QueueRisk] > CurrentRisk
                    || ([__QueueRisk] = CurrentRisk && Dim_Asset[asset_id] < CurrentAsset)
            )
        )
    )

tables.name: Param_DowntimeCost
tables.description: What-if downtime cost in CAD/hour, 0 to 2500 by 50. Default selected value 1000; effective only in uniform override mode.

tables.name: Param_CostMode
tables.description: Select equipment-specific rates or the uniform what-if rate. Equipment defaults preserves the baseline published scenario.

source.expression: let Source = #table(type table [#"Cost Mode"=text], {{"Equipment defaults"}, {"Uniform override"}}) in Source

tables.name: Param_Breakdown
tables.description: Native field parameter for chart axes. Uses NAMEOF plus groupByColumns and ParameterMetadata; not used in Q&A or Key Influencers.

tables.name: Dim_ConfusionActual
tables.description: Disconnected confusion-matrix axis; explicit measures exclude censored observations.

source.expression: let Source = #table(type table [Actual=text, Sort=Int64.Type], {{"Failure", 1}, {"No failure", 2}}) in Source

tables.name: Dim_ConfusionPredicted
tables.description: Disconnected confusion-matrix axis; explicit measures exclude censored observations.

source.expression: let Source = #table(type table [Predicted=text, Sort=Int64.Type], {{"Failure", 1}, {"No failure", 2}}) in Source

tables.name: Dim_CostStep
tables.description: Disconnected additive waterfall steps; three bars accumulate from reactive cost to predictive cost without double-counting a final total.

source.expression: let Source = #table(type table [Step=text, Sort=Int64.Type], {{"Reactive baseline", 1}, {"Fixed schedule change", 2}, {"Predictive change", 3}}) in Source

roles.name: Site Manager
roles.description: Dynamic allow-list security. Unknown UPNs receive zero sites/assets/facts; dimension labels and the mapping are secured too.

tablePermissions.name: Dim_Site
tablePermissions.filterExpression:
VAR CurrentUPN = LOWER(TRIM(USERPRINCIPALNAME()))
VAR CurrentSite = Dim_Site[site]
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(Dim_UserSite, LOWER(TRIM(Dim_UserSite[user_principal_name])) = CurrentUPN && Dim_UserSite[site] = CurrentSite)) > 0

tablePermissions.name: Dim_Asset
tablePermissions.filterExpression:
VAR CurrentUPN = LOWER(TRIM(USERPRINCIPALNAME()))
VAR CurrentSite = Dim_Asset[site]
RETURN COUNTROWS(FILTER(Dim_UserSite, LOWER(TRIM(Dim_UserSite[user_principal_name])) = CurrentUPN && Dim_UserSite[site] = CurrentSite)) > 0

expressions.name: DataFolder
expressions.description: Dashboard CSV directory; set this Power Query parameter before refresh.
